The '''Kalee system''', or '''Abbaji Minor system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including the planets [[Abbaji (Kalee system)|Abbaji Minor]] and [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] and [[Abbaji (Spar sector)|Abbaji]] in the same system according to ''[[Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous]]'' but a planet called Abbaji was first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'']] near [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The planet Abbaji near Kalee was eventually [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] as [[Abbaji (Kalee system)|Abbaji Minor]].<ref name="Atlas" />

[[Jason Fry]] also confirmed that, contrary to the [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]] article in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', [[Tovarskl]] is in a separate system than Kalee, like represented on the [[Pentastar Alignment]] map.<ref name="Atlas2">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30387023|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-28|time=11:05 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180225165344/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-109}}</ref>
